title: Approve vaginal pH modulation for on-demand non-hormonal contraception

concept.text: Enable woman-controlled pregnancy prevention through a non-hormonal vaginal pH-modulating product used around intercourse. Phexxi achieved approval, but its efficacy is substantially below long-acting contraception. Proposed completion test: FDA approval specifically for on-demand pregnancy prevention, based on a phase 3 study measuring cumulative pregnancy incidence over seven menstrual cycles and reviewing local and urinary safety. Test set by: FDA; its review accepted a seven-cycle cumulative pregnancy rate of 13.7% with a 95% confidence interval of 10.0–17.5%. This was not a Pearl Index below 2. Reported achieved: FDA approved Phexxi on 22 May 2020. Sources given: [FDA Phexxi approval letter](https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/appletter/2020/208352Orig1s000ltr.pdf) ; [FDA multidisciplinary efficacy and safety review](https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/nda/2020/208352Orig1s000MultidisciplineR.pdf).
